class.name: SteamLobbies
class.brief_description: Steam discovery and standalone social membership for one exact client scope.

method.name: is_available
method.description: Return whether this exact attachment can query Steam lobbies.

method.name: current
method.description: Return this scope's current exact lobby, or null when it has none.

method.name: query
method.description: Build a detached gameplay lobby query. The namespace defaults to the configured Game namespace or [code]crimson[/code] for standalone clients. A standalone query can opt into social lobbies with [method SteamLobbyQuery.social].

method.name: friend_lobby
method.description: Read a Steam friend's matching-AppID lobby locator when available. The game verifies its live namespace and owner on join.

method.name: create
method.description: Create a standalone social lobby. Null options use the private default. An existing membership or pending native acquisition in this account returns [constant ERR_BUSY]. A Game scope returns [constant ERR_UNAUTHORIZED].

method.name: join
method.description: Enter a standalone lobby and recheck its live social protocol, namespace, and Steam owner. A known Game listing is rejected locally. A Game scope cannot submit standalone membership.

signal.name: invite_received
signal.description: Emitted by a standalone scope after the user accepts a Steam lobby invite. The listing is a candidate and must be explicitly joined.
